title: User signs up with Google
description: As a new user, I want to sign up for the application using my existing Google account, so that I can create an account quickly and securely without needing to create and remember a new password.
business_value: Reduces registration friction, increasing user acquisition rates and securing user data via trusted third-party identity providers.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful sign-up for a new user","given":"I am a new user on the login screen","when":"I tap 'Sign in with Google' and successfully authenticate","then":"A new user account is created with 'Free User' role, session JWTs are issued, and I am redirected to onboarding"},{"scenario":"Google authentication fails","given":"I am on the login screen","when":"The Google authentication process fails due to network error","then":"I am returned to the login screen and no user account is created"},{"scenario":"Existing user logs in via sign-up button","given":"I have an existing account","when":"I authenticate with the same Google account","then":"I am logged in directly to the Dashboard without creating a new account"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-AUTH-001: Implement Social Login Token Exchange & Validation","WI-AUTH-002: Implement Mobile Login Screen & Social SDK Integration"]
definition_of_done: ["Google Sign-In flow functions on iOS and Android","Backend validates ID tokens via Auth0","User record created in Aurora DB","JWT stored securely in Keychain/Keystore"]

title: User searches for a book by title
description: As a Reader, I want to search for a book by typing its title so that I can quickly find and add the specific book I want to track to my personal library.
business_value: Enables the core value proposition of library management and data entry, essential for user retention and tracking engagement.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful search with results","given":"I am on the 'Add Book' screen","when":"I enter a valid book title","then":"A list of relevant books is displayed with covers, titles, and authors"},{"scenario":"External API failure","given":"The Google Books API is unavailable","when":"I attempt a search","then":"The system displays a user-friendly error and logs the failure via Circuit Breaker"},{"scenario":"Search yields no results","given":"I enter a non-existent title","when":"The search completes","then":"A 'No results found' message is displayed"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-LIB-001: Implement Google Books API Proxy with Resilience"]
definition_of_done: ["Google Books API proxy implemented with Polly resilience","Search UI displays results with images","API keys secured in AWS Secrets Manager","Unit tests for search query handler pass"]

title: User's offline changes are synced automatically
description: As a user, I want my offline changes to automatically synchronize with the server when I reconnect to the internet, so that my data is always backed up and consistent across devices.
business_value: Ensures data integrity and app reliability, preventing data loss and enabling usage in low-connectivity environments.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Sync on reconnection","given":"I have made changes while offline","when":"My device regains network connectivity","then":"Background sync triggers and pushes changes to the server"},{"scenario":"Conflict resolution","given":"The server has newer data than my device","when":"Synchronization occurs","then":"The 'Last Write Wins' strategy resolves the conflict based on timestamps"},{"scenario":"Local persistence","given":"I am offline","when":"I add a book or log a session","then":"Data is stored in the local Isar database marked as 'dirty'"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-LIB-002: Implement Library Synchronization Endpoint","WI-LIB-003: Implement Local Database Schema & Repository (Isar)","WI-LIB-004: Implement Background Synchronization Service"]
definition_of_done: ["Isar schema defined with sync fields","Background worker triggers on connectivity change","Backend endpoint handles batch updates atomically","Conflict resolution logic verified with tests"]

title: User purchases Premium subscription
description: As a Free User, I want to purchase a Premium subscription using my device's app store so that I can unlock unlimited features and remove advertisements.
business_value: Direct revenue generation through conversion of free users to paid subscribers, sustaining the business model.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Successful purchase","given":"I am on the Upgrade screen","when":"I complete the native in-app purchase flow","then":"My account is upgraded to 'Premium', ads are removed, and premium features unlock"},{"scenario":"Backend validation","given":"A purchase token is generated","when":"The app sends the receipt to the backend","then":"The backend validates the webhook/receipt with the App Store and updates the DB"},{"scenario":"Purchase cancellation","given":"I am in the purchase flow","when":"I cancel the transaction","then":"I remain on the Upgrade screen with 'Free' status and no error is shown"}]
technical_tasks: ["WI-SUB-001: Implement Subscription Webhook Handlers","WI-SUB-003: Implement In-App Purchase Flow (Flutter)","WI-SUB-002: Implement Tier-Based Feature Gating Middleware"]
definition_of_done: ["IAP flow works in Sandbox/TestFlight","Webhooks correctly update user roles in DB","Premium UI state persists across restarts","Receipt validation logic is secure"]

title: Premium User requests AI book recommendation
description: As a Premium User, I want to receive personalized book recommendations based on my reading history, so that I can discover new content tailored to my interests.
business_value: High-value differentiator for the Premium tier, driving upgrades and increasing user engagement through personalized discovery.
acceptance_criteria: [{"scenario":"Generate recommendation","given":"I am a Premium User with reading history","when":"I request a recommendation","then":"The system analyzes my history and returns a relevant book suggestion using AI"},{"scenario":"Data processing","given":"I have added new books","when":"The nightly embedding job runs","then":"My user context vector is updated in OpenSearch"},{"scenario":"Service resilience","given":"The LLM API is slow","when":"I make a request","then":"The system handles timeouts gracefully and does not crash the app"}]
